name: Draft Desk
description: Outbound-draft approval desk — your agent drafts email, LinkedIn, and X messages; you approve, nothing sends without you.

agent.label: Agent that drafts and sends outbound messages for you

intents.name: drafts_requested
intents.description: The owner asked for more drafts. Scan the connected sources (email, LinkedIn, X) for messages that need a reply and create a draft for each via the drafts API, skipping anything already queued.

intents.name: draft_revision_requested
intents.description: The owner commented on a draft and wants it rewritten. Read the owner's comment on the draft and rewrite the draft body in the owner's voice, then set it back to needs_review.

intents.name: draft_send_requested
intents.description: The owner approved a draft from the workbench. Send the draft to its captured recipient via the matching skill (email->gmail, linkedin/linkedin_comment->linkedin, x->twitter), then mark it sent. Never modify the draft body.

operations.name: listQueue
operations.description: List drafts the agent still needs to work (revision queue).

operations.name: listDrafts
operations.description: List drafts, optionally filtered by status and source.

operations.name: getDraft
operations.description: Get one draft with its full revision history.

operations.name: createDraft
operations.description: Create an outbound draft after processing one thread. Capture source, recipient/send_target, the real recent thread messages, and the draft body.

operations.name: updateDraft
operations.description: Update a draft's body or status (e.g. set a rewritten body back to needs_review). Author 'milo' marks an agent rewrite.

operations.name: markSent
operations.description: Mark a draft sent after the underlying skill delivers it.

operations.name: sendFailed
operations.description: Report a failed send; returns the draft to needs_review with the reason recorded so the owner can retry.

operations.name: markFulfilled
operations.description: Mark a fetch-more request fulfilled after creating new drafts for it.

agentInterface.instructions: You draft outbound messages into Draft Desk and never send them without an approved task action. When Draft Desk sends you a `drafts_requested` intent, scan the connected sources for messages that need a reply and create one draft per thread via POST /api/drafts (capture the source, the exact recipient/send_target, the real recent thread messages, and a reply written in the owner's voice). When it sends `draft_revision_requested`, read the owner's comment on that draft and rewrite the body in their voice, then set it back to needs_review. When it sends `draft_send_requested`, send the named draft to its captured recipient via the matching skill (email->gmail, linkedin and linkedin_comment->linkedin, x->twitter) and then POST /api/drafts/:id/sent; if the send fails, POST /api/drafts/:id/send-failed with the reason. NEVER send, post, or deliver a message unless the owner approved it - approval always originates from a Draft Desk task action or an explicit send intent, never on your own initiative. Never invent recipients; use the send_target captured on the draft.
